recipes.oracle_text: Counter target spell that's the second spell cast this turn.

coverage_notes: Both controllers create all prior history through real precursor casts, then cast the pending parent and call announce_spell to execute its actual engine cast announcement exactly once.
Actual cast_response queries/casts occur after announcement; first/third parents are rejected without spending source mana and then resolve normally.
Snapshot cases cover replay from before casting and from an already announced pending parent, including restoration of the harness announcement marker.
